## 5.2 Group comparison

Targeted compounds are compared by their concentrations, non-targeted features by their normalized,
blank-subtracted intensities (features detected in at least half of the study samples), with the
Wilcoxon rank-sum test [@wilcoxon1945]; the q-values are the p-values adjusted for the false discovery
rate over all compared features [@benjamini1995].
`r if (!LLOX_IMPUTED) "Concentrations below the LOD / LLOQ (n.d. / n.q., no value) count as the lowest ranks in the test; a median among them is shown as missing." else ""`
`r if (length(study_classes) > 2) paste0("The data has ", length(study_classes), " study groups; the first two (", study_classes[1], ", ", study_classes[2], ") are compared.") else ""`

```{r}
#| results: asis
grp <- study_classes[1:2]
# Study samples of the two groups after outlier removal (the data that is compared)
nt_ids <- feat$feature_id[feat$type == "Non-targeted"]
nt_m <- do.call(cbind, lapply(tr[["normalized - blank"]], \(se) se[[BLK]][nt_ids, , drop = FALSE]))
nt_cd <- bind_rows(lapply(tr[["normalized - blank"]], \(se) tibble::as_tibble(SumExp::col_df(se))))
g1 <- nt_cd$Class == grp[1] & nt_cd$.ctrl_cat == ""
g2 <- nt_cd$Class == grp[2] & nt_cd$.ctrl_cat == ""
n_grp <- c(sum(g1), sum(g2))
if (any(n_grp < 2)) {
  few <- which(n_grp < 2)
  cat(note(paste0("No group comparison: it needs at least 2 study samples in each group, and ",
                  paste0(grp[few], " has ", n_grp[few], collapse = " and "),
                  " (after outlier removal).")), "\n\n")
} else {
  cat(knitr::knit_child(file.path(chapters_dir, "internal-group-tests.qmd"), quiet = TRUE))
}
```

## 5.3 Concentrations per group

The 12 compounds quantified in the most study samples.

```{r}
#| fig-height: 8
#| fig-width: 13
top <- study_long |> group_by(feature_name) |> summarise(v = mean(status == "Valid")) |>
  filter(v > 0) |> arrange(desc(v)) |> head(12) |> pull(feature_name)
if (length(top) == 0) note("No quantified compounds in the study samples.") else
conc_long |> filter(feature_name %in% top, status == "Valid", .ctrl_cat %in% c("", "QC")) |>
  mutate(group = ifelse(.ctrl_cat == "QC", "QC", Class)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = group, y = conc, fill = group)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = .6) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = group_colors, guide = "none") +
  facet_wrap(~feature_name, scales = "free_y", ncol = 4) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = paste0("Concentration [", unit, "] (log10)"))
```
